Fixtures/CI prove selection logic, not a new independent live UI proof; C33 keeps local same-user adversarial impersonation out of scope. Rust JUnit on exact-head CI included trust default/refusal and Claude deny-to-trust transition witnesses. magicWand: reuse the existing dependency-free review-readiness follow-up (2026-11-17), adding read-only exact-head/CI evidence without builds or shared configuration changes. difficulty: checks offers only full or quick test-running modes; do not run either against a no-build review packet.
